description: This file defines the EntityConditionVisitor interface, which implements the visitor pattern for entity conditions in the OFBiz framework. It includes method signatures for visiting various entity condition types such as EntityNotCondition, EntityConditionList, EntityFieldMap, EntityDateFilterCondition, EntityExpr, and EntityWhereString.

classes.name: EntityConditionVisitor
classes.description: Interface for visiting different types of entity conditions, following the visitor design pattern.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Method signatures for visiting specific entity condition types such as EntityNotCondition, EntityConditionList, EntityFieldMap, EntityDateFilterCondition, EntityExpr, and EntityWhereString.
